commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Thomas Leonard has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Jordan Teze (Monaco) sees a yellow card from Thomas Leonard after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+3' Mama Balde (Brest) gets free in the box and latches onto a good cross, but somehow he sends the ball narrowly wide of the right post from the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat.
90+2' Jordan Teze (Monaco) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Pathe Mboup (Brest) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
88' Brest are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
85' 16:12 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
83' Sebastien Pocognoli has decided to substitute Vanderson and he is replaced by Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
83' Substitution. Lucas Tousart (Brest) on for Joris Chotard.
83' Substitution. Romain Del Castillo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest).
82' Jordan Teze (Monaco) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
78' Today's referee Thomas Leonard rightly decides to book Pathe Mboup (Brest) for his harsh tackle.
77' Here is a change. Lamine Camara is going off and Sebastien Pocognoli gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Michal (Monaco).
77' Here comes a substitution. Takumi Minamino is given a rest as he is replaced by Paris Brunner (Monaco).
76' The ball is out of play. Monaco win a corner kick.
76' Mama Balde (Brest) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
74' Monaco fail to score from a corner as Gregoire Coudert (Brest) leaps to collect the ball.

73' Vanderson (Monaco) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now. Monaco force a corner. They send men into the box.
71' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 2:1.
70' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) launches a cross from the corner, but Lukas Hradecky is alert to thwart the effort.
69' It will be a substitution. Pathe Mboup (Brest) is ready to enter the pitch as Kamory Doumbia walks off.
69' Sebastien Pocognoli prepares a substitution. Mamadou Coulibaly is replaced by Paul Pogba (Monaco).
69' We are about to witness a substitution. Stanis Idumbo (Monaco) is replacing Aleksandr Golovin.
67' A pass from Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is intercepted by Gregoire Coudert and the move breaks down.
65' Jordan Teze (Monaco) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
63' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Mika Biereth (Monaco) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
62' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
60' Thomas Leonard shows a red card with no hesitation. Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) can have an early bath and think about his challenge.
60' He’s off! Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) gets his marching orders from referee Thomas Leonard after the VAR review.
59' It’s not actually clear who made that challenge, so referee Thomas Leonard will consult VAR before possibly issuing a red card.
58' Lamine Camara (Monaco) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
56' Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

54' This should have been a goal! Daouda Guindo (Brest) takes a mid-range free kick and his effort flies straight as an arrow, but crashes against the crossbar. The keeper only turned his head and stared at the ball.
53' Brest are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
52' Thomas Leonard shows a yellow card to Vanderson (Monaco) for a tough tackle.
52' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Monaco! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Thomas Leonard and both teams have no complaints.

52' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Monaco.
50' Jordan Teze (Monaco) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
49' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Hugo Magnetti (Brest). A free kick has been awarded to Monaco.
46' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle. Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest) commits a foul after dangerous play.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Thomas Leonard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) dummies a defender then lets fly from the edge of the box, but the ball misses the left post by a mile.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' A yellow card for a tackle by Kamory Doumbia (Brest). Thomas Leonard doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
43' Mika Biereth receives a sweet cross inside the box from Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
41' Kenny Lala (Brest) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.

39' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the right post.
38' Mika Biereth (Monaco) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it well wide of the left post.
38' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
36' The referee points to the corner flag and Brest will take a corner.
36' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Brest are awarded a corner kick.
34' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Gregoire Coudert is prepared to thwart his effort.
32' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Mama Balde.
30' It doesn’t look good for Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
28' 1 - 0 Kamory Doumbia (Brest) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
28' A tremendous drive by Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Lukas Hradecky makes a brilliant save.
27' Caio Henrique (Monaco) was probably a bit loose with his words to Thomas Leonard, who decides to show him a yellow.
26' Kenny Lala (Brest) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
23' The free kick is taken by Jordan Teze (Monaco), but ball is cleared.
22' Daouda Guindo (Brest) was too forceful with his tackle and Thomas Leonard interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Monaco are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
20' Great chance! Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
19' Caio Henrique (Monaco) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
17' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
15' Chance! Mika Biereth (Monaco) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but Gregoire Coudert is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
14' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
12' A cross into the box from Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is cleared.
10' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Thomas Leonard didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
8' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
5' Daouda Guindo (Brest) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom right corner and forces a good save out of Lukas Hradecky.
4' One of the players from Monaco times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
2' Monaco are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Monaco will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Thomas Leonard.
